name: timidness
description: A desire to avoid outcomes where there's a prediction of any type of danger or chance of failure.
perceptions: It's important that I avoid any type of physical or social injury.
It would be best to avoid outcomes that could result in injury, anxiety, or failure.
results: May avoid getting involved in activities or social interactions.
examples: Never taking a shot in basketball.

guidance.description: Successful performances require a certain level of fearlessness. This is because there must be an underlying acceptance and acknowledgment of the possibility of failure.

commentaries.quote: A timid mind is apt to mistake every scratch for a mortal wound.
Don't be too timid and squeamish about your actions. All life is an experiment. The more experiments you make the better.
Timid men prefer the calm of despotism to the tempestuous sea of liberty.
A timid act may be more bold than one would first assume, for whispering truth is braver than to silently resume.
